title: Understanding Agglomerative Clustering
text: Agglomerative clustering starts with each data point as its own cluster and merges the closest clusters step by step. In single linkage, the distance between two clusters is defined as the shortest distance between any two points in the clusters.

title: Single Linkage Clustering
text: In single linkage clustering, the distance between two clusters is the minimum distance between any single point in one cluster and any single point in the other cluster. This can lead to elongated clusters.
